name: Big-tech product tour — directing bible
one_liner: 한 프레임 = 한 의도. 빛·커서·보이스·카메라가 같은 타임라인에 묶인다.

philosophy.master: VO leads, screen follows — never the reverse
philosophy.focus_rule: Exactly one primary focus target per beat phase
anti_patterns: cursor parked on unrelated metrics while VO talks about CTA
spotlight larger than half the viewport without reason
STEP caption from beat N while camera shows beat N+2 section
free-running demoClick animations stacked without hold
expand-all then click accordion (no visible state change)

zoom.note: community A: playwright-recast autoZoom / Screen Studio language

layers.L0_site: Real page — never replace with mock
layers.L1_dim_spotlight: Hole + gold ring — PRIMARY focus language
layers.L2_cursor: SVG cursor path + multi-ripple + CLICK badge
layers.L3_chrome: progress bar + PRODUCT TOUR chip + STEP caption
layers.L4_voice: TTS-first beat audio — master clock (freeze video if VO longer)
layers.L5_intro: 2.0s HTML title card only (CJK) — then hard cut to L0

rules: phase establish|focus|act|hold → light ON primary target
phase release → light OFF (opacity 0) before next camera move
primary target = click target if beat has clicks, else camera selector heading
if target height > max_height → focus inner heading/button, never whole section
cursor always ends on primary focus after each phase
never leave cursor on stats grid / random body while VO continues
nav links (# or http): visual demo only — no real navigation
chip + caption update ONLY at beat boundary (not mid-click)
caption must name the section currently in frame
one camera action per beat (goto_top | scroll_to)
after scroll, primary focus must be in center third of viewport
never scroll during VO of a different section

beat_phases.description: Every beat is a 5-phase unit. Shoot MUST implement this order. Timings are fractions of beat_audio_sec + pads.

do: set chip + caption + progress for this beat
focus primary (light ON) — no click yet
real click only if non-nav interactive
accordion: ensure closed then open (visible state change)
keep light + cursor on result of act (opened panel / CTA)
no second random click unless beat declares clicks[1+]

extra_clicks.note: If beat has 2+ clicks, repeat focus→act for each, then single hold for remainder

sync.rule: sum(phase ms) ≈ audio_sec + pad_sec for that beat
never: run full audio_sec hold AFTER full demoClick stack without subtracting
let click animations push later beats out of VO

voice.style: short editorial KO — concrete nouns, no filler templates

pre_tour.reason: accordion open must be a visible beat

primary_story: tracks accordion open — care vs aspiration
